title: Commons Phase 0: baseline verified and first Cisco-inspired visual checkpoint on the Mac/frame journey
statement: Baseline checks pass at b265422 (typecheck, 197 tests, index, build, three smoke scripts). Search results and the record page for 'My Mac cannot see my frame' now use a provisional token layer, a keyboard-accessible 'Why it matched' built from the ranking's structured matches, and a context bar carrying the situation via optional ?q= on record links. Backend, corpus and CLI/MCP/HTTP contracts unchanged. Proposes keeping the current Vite/hash-router stack for Phase 1. No human review recorded.
conditions: Tokens are provisional; no Cisco Cloud Control screen was inspected and the PDF workbench uses a different accent (#087E8B).
Two ATProto suites return early without tools/local-pds; screen reader, touch and non-Chromium checks not run.
blackmath88/development-practice could not be read from this session; the TanStack recommendation rests on the in-repo PDF workbench only.
The context packet's cutoff 93a5445 predates this base; used as background only.
